display_long_description:
Step into the world of immersive virtual bowling with Vestibowl — a fun and accessible VR bowling experience built exclusively for Meta Quest.

Designed for both casual players and VR enthusiasts, Vestibowl combines intuitive gameplay, satisfying physics-based bowling mechanics, and immersive virtual environments to create a relaxing and entertaining experience in virtual reality.

Although Vestibowl is technically a single-player game, up to four players can take turns using the VR headset, creating a social bowling experience similar to real-world bowling nights with friends and family.

Whether you want to enjoy a quick bowling session, improve your precision, or simply experience the feeling of bowling in VR, Vestibowl offers smooth controls and engaging gameplay that is easy to pick up and enjoyable for all skill levels.

Features:
• Immersive VR bowling gameplay
• Realistic physics-based ball movement
• Easy and intuitive controls
• Social local multiplayer experience by taking turns
• Comfortable and accessible VR experience
• Designed specifically for Meta Quest devices
• Relaxing atmosphere with engaging gameplay

Vestibowl focuses on fun, immersion, and accessibility while delivering an enjoyable virtual bowling experience for players of all ages.

Supported devices:
Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest Pro, Meta Quest 3, and Meta Quest 3S.
